reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Line removed from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go: log.Info(\"Composition Functions are GA and cannot be disabled. The --enable-composition-functions flag will be…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: If the Crossplane core pod is still started with --enable-composition-functions after the v2.0.0 upgrade, the flag is no longer honoured; per the removed notice, Composition Functions are GA and cannot be disabled, so the flag had no disabling effect anyway.
consequence.remediation: Remove --enable-composition-functions from the Crossplane core pod arguments (Helm values args) when upgrading to v2.0.0.

proposed.statement: Crossplane v2.0.0 removed from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go the deprecation handling for --enable-composition-functions — the notice stating that Composition Functions are GA, cannot be disabled, and that the flag will be removed in a future release is gone, indicating the deprecated no-op flag was removed in v2.0.0.
